issue.title: ZEL Unattended Gate FSM
issue.body:
## Authority
Single unattended controller for ZEL research-to-readiness progression. Immutable GitHub workflow artifacts are SSOT. No stage may advance without an explicit deterministic PASS receipt.

## Global locks
- Maximum one heavy VPS replay at a time.
- No duplicate strategy+axis+data-SHA replay.
- No canonical, registry, runtime, Formal Ledger, Shadow, Paper, Live, or order mutation during research stages.
- `selection_authority=false`, `promotion_authority=false`, `execution_authority=NONE`, `order_authority=BLOCKED` until the applicable later gate explicitly passes.
- Live/order remains forbidden without explicit user approval.

## Ordered stages
- [x] G0 Accept PR #559 exit-contract artifact
- [x] G1 Merge staged PR #564 into PR #560 head; accept EMA artifact
- [x] G2 Merge staged PR #565 into PR #562 head; accept Scalp artifact
- [x] G3 Finalize all 25 strategy dispositions
- [ ] G4 Produce 2–3 economic survivors or exhaust approved repair axes
- [ ] G5 Independent OOS/walk-forward/stress validation
- [ ] G6 Trade Method standalone
- [ ] G7 Skill standalone
- [ ] G8 LBot/MBot/OBot/SBot and ZBot/Zico/Lico/Zlice standalone
- [ ] G9 Selected interactions and strategy Top3 bundles
- [ ] G10 BingX fee/slippage/funding/latency calibration
- [ ] G11 Portfolio Joint Risk and rollback rehearsal
- [ ] G12 Shadow 200C/300C with lifecycle/ledger/display parity
- [ ] G13 30D Paper canary
- [ ] G14 Controlled Live readiness; user approval still required

## Research PASS gate
Every candidate must have exact source-owner and baseline trade/economic-digest parity; W1-only selection frozen through W2/W3; complete fee/slippage/funding lineage; errors=0; duplicate=0; censored-open=0; unknown-exit=0 where applicable; no future MFE/MAE leakage; no protected mutation. Economic survivor requires W1, W2, and W3 each: Net R>0, PF>=1, expectancy>0, payoff>=1, retention>=60%.

## Failure handling
Implementation/infrastructure defects: read-only diagnosis → one root cause → minimum patch → verify → at most two retries. Economic failure is recorded as terminal evidence and moves only to the next distinct approved causal axis; it is never treated as PASS. Secret/permission/quota/external-service blockers or the same cause failing twice force HOLD and user-authority request.

## User inspection
The controller must maintain one latest-state comment on this issue containing: stage, active PR/run/job, head SHA, artifact SHA, PASS/FAIL/HOLD, gate evidence, retry count, current blocker, next permitted action, and confirmation that Live/order authority is blocked. Ordinary in-progress updates need not notify the user; this issue remains the inspection surface.

Primary objective: find materially better economics — ideally T/WR/Net higher with DD/MaxLS lower — without threshold loosening, post-holdout retune, forced trades, or hidden legacy evidence. Weak lanes remain WATCH/REBUILD; do not force seven Core promotions. Orders/live remain BLOCKED.

issue.title: ZEL delegated profit-development owner — entry-edge pilot after PR1357
issue.body:
## Purpose and delegation
The user explicitly asked to stop requiring a new Chat instruction for every step, choose the execution owner, and automate development toward a profitable trading system. This is a bounded work order under the existing roadmap in #566, NOT a replacement roadmap, trading authorization, or profitability claim.

Owner route: one ChatGPT scheduled coordinator -> authenticated GitHub research branches/Actions -> saved-result verification and automated review -> next permitted work item. The interactive Chat is for user direction and exceptions, not a mandatory approval between ordinary steps. Creating this issue or a schedule does NOT prove autonomous execution. A separately created Work/Codex Cloud session is NOT claimed.

## Preserved baseline
PR1357 is merged at 59a0ba834c8978c2083739933a9748f1bfc6cf45. PR1355/1356/1357 and all claims, contracts, results and negative decisions remain immutable. PR1357's exit-only child remains negative and its entire improvement comes from one previously inspected DOGE trade. Do not rerun the consumed batches or continue the same exit/BE threshold axis. No implicit adoption of Keltner, Squeeze, materials or old Active5.

Authoritative starting references:
- #566 and current candidate-local contracts; later explicit user scope controls its own work, not unrelated lanes.
- backend/research/rebuild/economic_dev_execution_split_v1.json
- research/campaigns/scalp7_20261004/kp_input_validation_v1/REPORT.md
- research/campaigns/scalp7_20261004/clocked_lanes_v1/REPORT.md and COMPLETION.json
- research/campaigns/scalp7_20261005/squeeze_nonpositive_exit_v1/REPORT.md and COMPLETION.json
- PR1357 final receipt comment5993300192.
Read actual current authority before changing anything. Old 1h/4h/other-lane gates cannot be silently imposed on current 15m/30m candidates. Do not equate an old controller's existence or telemetry updates with this pilot's working execution.

## Ordered executable work, not a monitoring-only task
1. ENTRY_EVIDENCE: use saved signals, trades, source rules and point-in-time observations to decide whether current entry mechanics have a plausible cost-covering advantage or require replacement. Compare successes AND failures, opportunity availability, cost, timing assumptions, concentration and prior failed hypotheses. Nine recent Squeeze trades cannot be used to fit a classifier or to select a best threshold. Separate recorded facts, inferred mechanisms and untested hypotheses. Do not rerun old economics merely to recover totals.
2. FREEZE_ONE: select at most ONE justified entry-mechanism candidate from existing evidence and eligible roadmap work, with a clear economic mechanism, causal inputs, baseline, exact rules, fixed development period and source hashes, negative control, counterexample and stop criteria. It need not preserve a strategy name. No default move to the next numbered strategy, no generic filter stack, no new exit-threshold sweep. If evidence is insufficient, record the precise missing observable or falsification and do not invent a candidate.
3. IMPLEMENT_AND_TEST: reuse supported verified price/timing/accounting paths; create an isolated research branch and minimum implementation. Fail closed for unsupported pair/partial/microstructure profiles instead of pretending a universal engine exists. Follow current AGENTS instructions and canonical pre/post checks. Fix reproduced implementation defects, not observed losing outcomes. Obtain exact-source CI and review before activation.
4. BOUNDED_DEVELOPMENT_COMPARISON: maximum ONE new entry candidate and maximum TWO new full model executions TOTAL for this pilot (candidate once, and a matched control once only if a saved identical-condition control cannot be reused). This is a conservative limit within the user's research-development delegation, not replenishment of PR1355/1356/1357. Before any execution, commit the exact contract and allocation, verify relevant global heavy occupancy and other owners, and atomically reserve the new batch using the existing durable GitHub pattern. An uncertain prior launch is not zero. No economic retry after consumption; recovery reads the existing output. Any new period or additional candidate requires a separately applicable allocation, not automatic renewal.
5. AUDIT_AND_CLOSE: independently recompute saved results and verify causal event-to-fill links; report T, net WR, gross, all stated costs, net, expectancy, PF, DD kind, losing streak, lost/preserved winners and additional/missed trades, with exact run/artifact/source IDs. Use existing applicable decision criteria; do not invent a pass threshold or account NAV. Less negative is NOT a profitable strategy. Successful engineering is NOT economic PASS. Record a terminal disposition and the exact next eligible existing-roadmap item. A further task may proceed without another Chat message only if its own authority, allocation and input eligibility are actually established.

## Execution and anti-stall rules
- Advance within a run when possible; a new user message is not a prerequisite. Resume the active run/PR before opening a replacement.
- One coordinator and at most one heavy evaluator. Parallel read-only preparation may not duplicate execution ownership.
- Persist claim, active PR/head/run/job, input/contract/artifact hashes, consumed/remaining allocation, first failure and next action outside the chat sandbox. Never recreate a lost OWNER_ID or delete a claim to resume.
- Reuse the tested permanent-claim pattern; do not turn completed saved-only workflows back into economic executors.
- At most two minimal implementation-repair attempts for the same cause; economic losses are not implementation retry credits.
- If tool/permission/secret/quota is missing, record the exact failed action once. Do not claim a task is running because this issue or its prompt exists. Do not revive unrelated disabled automations.
- No broad platform rebuild, agent fleet, routine benchmark resurvey or repeated prior reconciliation as a substitute for this work.

## Nondelegated authority
No exchange orders/withdrawals, live or Paper activation, runtime/registry/production deployment, collector/service restart, paid external AI/API top-ups, billing changes, credential/security changes, deletion of evidence, weaker risk/acceptance gates, or OOS relabeling. Existing quotas apply. Research automation is not live execution authority. #1347/#1348 and other owners' lanes remain untouched.

## Completion proof and reporting
AUTOMATION_CONFIGURED requires a created enabled task ID. AUTONOMOUS_CYCLE_VERIFIED requires a real scheduled invocation that persists substantive work and proceeds to its permitted successor without a new user message; code/CI/economic stages must each expose their own actual receipts. Do not report the latter from setup alone.
Notify only meaningful economic dispositions, verified autonomous progression, or blockers requiring user action. No repeated no-change/CI-count updates. Respect Europe/Berlin 01:00-07:00 quiet hours except CRITICAL. Always make current work status inspectable in durable GitHub receipts.
If this pilot terminates and no separately authorized ready successor exists, pause the coordinator rather than silently inventing scope or running an hourly no-op indefinitely.

## Setup receipt — 2026-10-05
State: AUTOMATION_CONFIGURED; first autonomous cycle NOT_YET_VERIFIED.
Task title: ZEL 수익개발 총괄.
Scheduler reference: 6ac3a5ccef288191a55fb769ed6329b1.
Creation returned SUCCESS and is_enabled=true. Registered DTSTART20261005T132840Z, RRULE:FREQ=HOURLY, condition_watch, default timezone Europe/Berlin. This is scheduled ChatGPT coordination, not proof of a new Work/Codex Cloud environment or GitHub workflow deployment.
Source inspection anchor784ea0a5aa542d147fc0101cd8c5690f2057ac81. ENTRY_EVIDENCE is next, not complete. New pilot model invocations0, no new strategy implementation or economic result claimed at setup.

Subsequent coordinator runs must preserve this mandate, append actual timestamped receipts to this issue's progress section or a dedicated research branch, and retain the exact PR/run/artifact evidence. Read the latest body before updating it and do not overwrite concurrent owner progress. Manual continuation must recover this coordinator's current claim before starting competing work.

## ZEL FAST-FINISH: K117 최종 1축 개선 → 무주문 Shadow 준비 / 다른 전략 병렬 개발 (2026-10-22)

최신 사용자 지시: Keltner 하나를 무한 재튜닝하지 않는다. **현 개선본에서 증거 기반 개선 비교 최대 1회만 추가**한 뒤 K117 계열을 동결하고 Shadow 적격 판단으로 넘긴다. 다른 전략들은 개발·자료검토·코드시험을 병렬 진행한다. 단 경제 FULL owner는 `CLOUD_WORK_COORDINATOR_ISSUE1358_V1`, `global-heavy<=1` 그대로.

### 실제 새 완료 증거 (인계에 반드시 소비)
- K117 source/result `8a301b017414bdd612fbd2ac7f0b5c5bc25d53a8`: used-DEV 245일/117T, Net 1x `+10159.28114592 trade-bps`, 2x `+8399.99437120`, 연패 5/11, 개발 경제 양수 / **OOS·계좌 NAV·Shadow PASS 아님**.
- 기존 C/D passive trace는 run `39769638039` jobs SUCCESS, 전체 117거래 원형 동일성/Gross-Cost=Net 확인. 결과 및 원시 트레이스 commit `91b51cad44bfd896e6918bf58e5eba5be105c746`, `research/campaigns/scalp7_20261022/k117_exit_improvement_parallel_v1/applied_20261022/completion/RESULT.md`. Owner TERMINAL/RELEASED `910f998b1d60ddec30a76366ba49253a4afaa8dd`. 새 정책 경제평가 0·주문 0.
- C: 기존 손실 46건 중 43건에서 청산 전 불리한 확정봉 종가가 나타났지만, 승리 71건 중 35건에도 있다. **단순 첫 역행종가 청산은 미검증/복구승리 훼손 위험**.
- D: 비용 증가 시 손실로 바뀌는 28건 중 25건에서 실제 BE 보호 발동, 그 25건의 BE 발동→청산 중앙값 60분, 부분익절 1·러너 0. C/D 결과를 다른 코드 작성/observer 재실행 없이 사용하라.

### 운영 변경 — K117에서 개발 스프린트 종료
1. K117을 불변 incumbent로 둔다. 이번 trace에서 그날 당시 관측 가능하고 회복 승리 반례를 구별하는 증거가 있을 때에만 **D의 BE/미약승리 보존 또는 C의 초기실패 방어 중 구체적인 단일 축 하나**를 결과 보기 전에 동결한다. 승인된 잔여 경제예산·중복·원본 및 owner/slot을 확인한 후 해당 변경을 기존 A에서 **최대 1회** 전체 시간순 비교한다. 출처 없는 임계값 조정, 1x만 PASS, 지는 거래 사후 제거, 2개 축 동시 변경 금지. 근거 없는 경우 억지 시험하지 않고 최종 비교 0회로 개발 종료.
2. 기존 K117 vs 마지막 child를 Net1x/2x·PF·T·T/day·연패 횟수와 누적손실·cohort-DD·34개 큰 승리·회복 승리·새/놓친 진입·비용·미결·원장SHA로 판정한다. 유효 child만 보존하고 그렇지 않으면 `8a301b01` 채택. **이 판정이 끝나면 K117 개발은 CLOSED_FROZEN; 신규 K 미세조정 금지.**
